description:
Create a new menu item 'Firecracker Shrimp' ($12.99) and configure it to have a RED button with WHITE text for high visibility.

1. Go to Back Office (PIN: 1111) > Explorers > Menu Items
2. Add a new item named 'Firecracker Shrimp' with price $12.99
3. Assign it to any valid group (e.g., Main Course)
4. Change the Button Color to RED and Text Color to WHITE using the 'Button Color' and 'Text Color' selectors (you may need to look in the 'Visuals' or 'Button Style' tab if present, or look for the color buttons directly on the form)
5. Ensure the item is Visible and Save it
